title: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
claim: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template — Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
why_good: One-command website cloning via coding agents — a catchy demo, but it's a template/script, and cloning sites is legally and ethically fraught.
value: Weak/questionable monetization; 'clone any site' invites IP problems more than paying customers.
risk: It's a template not a product, trivially copied, and the core use case (copying others' sites) is a legal minefield.
